features.body:
Package-owned MdWrk change request execution orders durable repository work by package owner and explicit owner set. It covers repo governance, package manifests, scoped agent instructions, SSOT proof rows, screenshot artifacts, client and desktop app changes, mdwrkcom host code, reusable packages, content packs, and generated static/discovery artifacts.

The feature explicitly excludes external redeploys, domain migrations, Google Search Console submissions, and equivalent third-party console or hosting operations. Those items must not be tracked as MdWrk repo-owned SSOT features unless a future ADR/SPEC creates a separate operations-owned scope outside the package change-request checklist.

issues.description: MdWrk.com light and dark themes define syntax color variables and Prism/HLJS token selectors in apps/mdwrkcom/styles/markdown-renderer.css, but @mdwrk/markdown-renderer-core renders fenced code as escaped plain text inside pre/code with only a language-* class. @mdwrk/markdown-renderer-react accepts syntaxTheme but currently ignores it, so no tokenizer emits .token.* or .hljs-* spans. The uniform code color rule then makes docs and blog code blocks render monochrome even when a language is present.
issues.title: Lander code blocks do not render syntax-colored tokens
